The image is ready.

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the workspace defines exactly one view (`SystemContext`, the system context view of the Library), so there's one image: Patron (person) → Library (software system) with the "Browses the catalogue through / HTTPS" relationship, title, and legend.

One transparency note: this environment has no PlantUML/Java/Graphviz and no external network (outbound DNS and connections are blocked; only loopback works), so I couldn't run a standard renderer. Instead I exported the view through the Structurizr tooling and generated the SVG directly, using the standard C4-PlantUML styling (Person `#084270`, System `#1168bd`, relationship `#999999`).

I also kept the exact PlantUML source at **`/work/SystemContext.puml`** — if you run it through any PlantUML engine (local install or plantuml.com), you'll get the canonical rendering of the same view.
